messages:
lucy_sdk: Heads-up: our edge sample can't resolve @redwood/sdk when consumed from the pnpm workspace on Vercel. Works if I run the sample with cwd=packages/sdk, but the deployed edge bundle errors during resolution. Anyone seen weirdness with .mjs vs .js + type:module + exports maps?

tere_devex: Yep. Bundlers in edge mode (esbuild or tooling used by platforms) are sensitive to file extensions and the package's "type" field. If package.json is "type":"module" and exports point at .mjs, some resolver plugins expect .js or need explicit conditions.

charles_build: Can you paste the minimal package.json for the SDK? Also paste the exact error from the build.

lucy_sdk: Here's the SDK package.json snippet we ship:```json
{"name":"@redwood/sdk","type":"module","exports":{"import":"./dist/index.mjs","require":"./dist/index.cjs"},"main":"dist/index.cjs","module":"dist/index.mjs","types":"dist/index.d.ts"}
```
Build log:```text
> [esbuild] Could not resolve "@redwood/sdk" from /workspace/apps/edge/src/entry.ts
> 1 │ import { createClient } from "@redwood/sdk"
  ╵   Could not resolve "@redwood/sdk"
```

olga_ts: Two things I ran into recently: 1) some bundlers prefer a package-level bare import condition (".") instead of top-level import/require only; 2) tsserver sometimes can't pick up types when the package uses .mjs and type:module with pnpm symlinks.

tere_devex: Actionable suggestions: add an explicit conditional export for '.' and a './package.json' export. Example:```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": {"edge":"./dist/edge.mjs","default":"./dist/index.mjs"},
    "require":"./dist/index.cjs"
  },
  "./package.json": "./package.json",
  "./*": "./dist/*"
}
```
That makes bundlers and tools able to read package.json and pick the edge variant.

charles_build: Also try adding a "browser" field if you want bundlers to prefer smaller/browser-compatible builds: "browser": "dist/edge.mjs". Some bundlers consult that condition. And set "module" to the ESM entry (.mjs or .js) consistently.

lucy_sdk: TS server still flagged `Could not find declaration file for module '@redwood/sdk'` locally (in VS Code) even after adding types. Any tips?

olga_ts: For pnpm, tsc/tsserver sometimes resolves via the virtual store path; a reliable pattern is to expose a root d.ts proxy at the package root as a fallback: create types.d.ts with `export * from './dist/index.d.ts'` and point package.json "types" to that root file. Or use typesVersions to map import paths.

tere_devex: Another approach: in repo's root tsconfig, add a path mapping during dev:```json
"paths": {"@redwood/sdk": ["packages/sdk/dist/index.d.ts", "packages/sdk/src"]}
```
But that only helps monorepo editors, not external consumers. For shipping, prefer packaging the d.ts at root or export it via "./*": "./dist/*".

charles_build: We also had an issue where an auth side-effect (patching global fetch to attach tokens) was tree-shaken away in edge bundles because it was only imported by a helper that wasn't referenced. Fix: include an explicit import at top of the edge entrypoint (dist/edge.mjs) like `import './auth/patch-fetch.js'` so bundlers can't drop it. Alternatively mark it as a side-effect in package.json: "sideEffects": ["./auth/patch-fetch.js"].

lucy_sdk: That maps to the bug I saw where token refresh stopped on Vercel preview only. We'll add the explicit import in edge entry.

ci-bot: quick log snippet from recent CI run:```text
esbuild failed: Could not resolve "@redwood/sdk"
Warning: TS2307: Cannot find module '@redwood/sdk'.
```

tere_devex: Short-term dev workaround: add a small index.js (or index.mjs depending on type) at package root that re-exports the dist entry. Example (index.mjs): `export * from './dist/index.mjs';` and point exports to include "." -> "./index.mjs". Then CI and editors in workspaces can resolve consistently while we tidy exports.

olga_ts: And add a repo-level smoke job to CI that builds the sample app from the repo root: `pnpm --filter apps/edge build`. That catches these packaging/resolve issues before external publishing.

lucy_sdk: OK I'm going to open a tiny PR: add '.' export, './package.json' export, provide 'edge' conditional import, add root index.mjs proxy for a short transition, and explicit import of auth patch. I'll also add a note in the sample app README about local workspace dev quirks.

charles_build: Thanks. Also let's add a 1-line checklist to devex docs so maintainers remember the mjs/type:module + pnpm interactions.

lucy_sdk: Will do and ping when the PR is up :rocket:
